text:
QUOTE: "Any function returning `char*` transfers ownership. Free it with `entropic_free()`." and "Engine-owned `const char*` values are not freed by the caller. They belong to the handle and stay valid only until the next call on that handle."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves of the rule: a returned char* is caller-owned and freed with entropic_free, and a const char* belongs to the handle and is valid only until the next call on it.
